content.short: Joba Network is the identity network for the future of work.
content.description: Build an on-chain resume and reputation that opens new opportunities. Joba Network enables you to hire or apply for jobs with secure, contract-based interactions and verifiable professional identity on-chain. Its project-based approach lets talents and employers craft clear, tailored agreements that define milestones, payments, and responsibilities, helping reduce scams and miscommunication. By recording credentials, work history, and endorsements on the blockchain, you create a portable professional profile trusted across opportunities and networks, enabling more confident collaborations.
